+ - a later milestone offers several applicable skills or goals with real
Agree. The ultimate goal is to beat nethack. For now, if the scenarios are still easy and can be dealt with deterministic scripts, we don't need to depend on LLM. I think the LLM will become more important when we need to make high level decisions (Should I take the risk and go down the stairs? Or should I farm and gain more level? Should I pray to get out of risk? What is the most dangerous monster on screen that I should deal first... )
NOTE that: the nethack agent can deal with unknown / unfamiliar situations in an episode. Later, the coding agent can review what nethack agent did, and either update the knowledge to provide better guideline, or if the decision is very simple, then make a deterministic skill.

+ - An unlocked closed door can be opened with the open command and may open when moved into if `autoopen` is enabled. A locked door will not open normally; first look for another route rather than forcing it.
The "if `autoopen` is enabled" statement is not necessary if we have decided to start the nethack-agent with or without `autoopen` enabled. I don't think we need to allow the nethack-agent to decide this, right?

+ - Staircases themselves are never secret, but an item or monster can cover one, and the room containing one can be behind a secret door or hidden corridor.
regarding "an item or monster can cover one", does the NLE tell the agent where are staircases even if it is covered?
